payload.description_html:
A view of the juvenile Camarasaurus exhibit on the bottom floor of the Quarry Exhibit Hall. It features a replica of a young Camarasaurus skeleton that was found in lifelike position.

Here is the Camarasaurus exhibit on the bottom floor of the Quarry Exhibit Hall. It's the closest exhibit to the bottom of the interior ramp.
